name: bazi-academy
description: Learn Chinese astrology (BaZi / Four Pillars of Destiny) – Android app

scripts.build:aab: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:apk: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios-sim: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
